stage0004_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$柿小路$$
「With no jobs coming in, it can't be helped.」

stage0004_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「But $$正太郎$$'s so busy with stuff!」

stage0004_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$厚井$$
「$$正太郎$$ is an $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ investigator.
　He'll be busy whenever a crook shows up.」

stage0004_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$柿小路$$
「And unlike him, we're a company.
　We can't launch the Trider without
　a job to answer.」

stage0004_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$柿小路$$
「I understand how you feel, sir.」

stage0004_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$厚井$$
「But even at the cheapest estimate, one
　sortie of the Trider costs a million yen.」

stage0004_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Y-yeah... hearing the number a million
　just gave me a headache.」

stage0004_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$厚井$$
「That's why, if the Trider went out on
　charity sorties, this company would
　go under in no time.」

stage0004_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$柿小路$$
「And then all our employees, and their
　families too, would be out on the street.」

stage0004_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey... were we always this short-staffed?」

stage0004_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I thought we had a cool guy and a
　tough-talking gunman around here...」

stage0004_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Maybe I'm catching a cold...
　My head's hurting again...」

stage0004_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$郁絵$$
「Then you should eat today's snack, the
　tanuki udon, and get to bed early.」

stage0004_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Ah well... not even tempura udon.
　That's how tight money is around here...」

stage0004_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$木下$$
「Sir, we did it!
　A walk-off grand slam in the bottom
　of the ninth!」

stage0004_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$木下$$
「Yes!
　An official request just came in from
　Director $$大塚$$ of the Crusher Team!!」

stage0004_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Still, man... you come home with fresh
　wounds every time you go to school.」

stage0004_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$クルツ$$
「The hell there isn't!
　I heard about your rampages from $n!」

stage0004_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$マオ$$
「Most of it's from false alarms...
　plus the injuries from that, and the
　protests from $$千鳥かなめ$$ and her classmates...」

stage0004_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm telling you it's a big deal!」

stage0004_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$マオ$$
「I get what you're trying to say.
　...You're wondering why $$ミスリル$$ is
　guarding $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

stage0004_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$宗介$$
「It is a mission. I have no intention of
　questioning it.」

stage0004_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Say what you want, but the boss and I
　are curious too.」

stage0004_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$マオ$$
「With unidentified parties lurking around
　that school, I don't think the mission
　itself is unnecessary...」

stage0004_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$マオ$$
「Suspicious person on the target's balcony!
　Moving in to investigate!」

stage0004_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$クルツ$$
「They're finally going after Angel
　directly!」

stage0004_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$マオ$$
「Just take him down!
　$$ウルズ$$ 6, snipe from the building across the street!
　$$ウルズ$$ 7, move to the scene!」

stage0004_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
???
「...I-I managed to get what I came for...」

stage0004_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$宗介$$
「You've lost.
　Don't make a sound.」

stage0004_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$宗介$$
「Good.
　Life is precious. Treat it that way.」

stage0004_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$クルツ$$
「$$ウルズ$$ 6 to $$ウルズ$$ 7.
　Take a real good look at what the
　intruder's holding.」

stage0004_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$宗介$$
「It appears to be a white cloth...」

stage0004_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「It's panties!
　Ahh... such pristine white!」

stage0004_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That's just a panty thief.
　We're pulling out, so wrap it up however
　you like. Over and out!」

stage0004_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$風間$$
「S-sor... I'm sorry!
　I'm sorry! I'm so sorry!
　Please, don't arrest me!」

stage0004_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$宗介$$
「Speak quietly.
　...Also, I am not the police.
　But you will explain the circumstances.」

stage0004_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$風間$$
「Ah, thank you...
　wait, you... Sagara?」

stage0004_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$風間信二$$, $$千鳥かなめ$$'s classmate.
　What are you doing here?」

stage0004_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$風間$$
「As you can see, stealing underwear.
　You too?」

stage0004_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$宗介$$
「No...!
　I was simply passing by!」

stage0004_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$風間$$
「Passing by...
　this is the third floor of a condo...」

stage0004_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$宗介$$
「What do you intend to do, stealing
　her clothing?」

stage0004_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$風間$$
「It's not that I want it.
　My photo club senpai just told me to do it...」

stage0004_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$風間$$
「The negatives of all the photos I've
　shot got taken by a third-year senpai...」

stage0004_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$風間$$
「And he said if I wanted them back,
　I had to steal Chidori's panties.」

stage0004_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$風間$$
「They're not bad people, not to that
　degree... 'You lack the guts to get close
　to your subject! This is training!' he said...」

stage0004_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$風間$$
「He said $$千鳥かなめ$$'s the idol he'd
　least want as a girlfriend, so she's just
　right for a test of nerve...」

stage0004_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$宗介$$
「I understand the situation, more or
　less, but it must trouble her.」

stage0004_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$風間$$
「Yeah...
　But I do want the negatives back...
　they're AS photos from bases all over Japan.」

stage0004_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$風間$$
「Sagara, you're into that stuff too, right?」

stage0004_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$宗介$$
「No, it's not that I'm 'into' it...」

stage0004_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$風間$$
「I got shots of the M6 deployed in
　Okinawa too!」

stage0004_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$風間$$
「Yeah, that's it!
　It was carrying a reactive-armor shield!」

stage0004_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$宗介$$
「How does it move, in practice?」

stage0004_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$風間$$
「I talked to a guy at the base, he said the
　balance is off. That thing's control
　system is Rockwell's MSO-12, right?」

stage0004_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$宗介$$
「No, I believe that was the eleven.」

stage0004_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$風間$$
「Was it? Anyway, its feedback architecture
　carries too much dead weight.」

stage0004_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$風間$$
「At this rate I think there'll be problems
　linking up with the $$ＧＮ－ＸⅣ$$ once it's deployed.」

stage0004_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$宗介$$
「I see...
　so deployment of the next-gen model with
　the pseudo-GN Drive is starting too...」

stage0004_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$宗介$$
「MS and AS...
　The tactical effects of how each is used could
　end up dragging down the whole force instead...」

stage0004_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$風間$$
「That's true.
　But that's exactly why I think AS units
　will need higher output going forward.」

stage0004_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Your knowledge is impressive.
　You hardly seem like a civilian.」

stage0004_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$風間$$
「I'm still nowhere near enough.
　You're the deep one, Sagara.」

stage0004_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm asking what you're doing gripping
　someone's panties!
　You perveeeeeert!!」

stage0004_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$宗介$$
「Guh...!
　I managed to get $$風間$$ away, but...」

stage0004_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
???
「You bastard!
　I'm turning a panty thief over to the police!」

stage0004_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$n
（$$宗介$$...
　what did you do last night?）

stage0004_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$n
（Chidori called in a real fury, but
　something about a pervert, I couldn't
　make out the rest）

stage0004_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$n
（He's in a terrible mood again today,
　and I'm stuck sitting right next to him）

stage0004_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$宗介$$
（Classified, but the man I clashed with
　last night... was skilled in hand-to-hand combat）

stage0004_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$宗介$$
（If $$クルツ$$ hadn't laid down cover fire there,
　I'd have been in trouble myself...）

stage0004_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You two, quiet down!
　Homeroom's about to start,
　so knock it off!」

stage0004_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$n
（Why am I dragged into this too...）

stage0004_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$恭子$$
「Kana, you're at max grumpiness today.」

stage0004_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$恭子$$
「But with a face like that,
　you'll scare off the new transfer student.」

stage0004_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$恭子$$
「Jindai High's the model school for the research city.
　We've got sister schools all over,
　so maybe it's an exchange from one of those.」

stage0004_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone's in their seats, good.
　Miss Kagurazaka is away today,
　so I'll be covering homeroom.」

stage0004_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「And I'd like to introduce
　a new classmate who's just transferred in.
　...Go on, come in.」

stage0004_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「So he's been causing trouble outside school too?」

stage0004_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$甲児$$
「So we meet again! I've got you now!」

stage0004_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Hold on, $$甲児$$.
　Don't make a scene right after transferring in.」

stage0004_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$アルト$$, $$宗介$$, do you two know each other?」

stage0004_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah, we went to the same school before.」

stage0004_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$早乙女アルト$$.
　Transferred in from Mihoshi Academy, Frontier Fleet.
　I was in space navigation, so flying's my hobby.」

stage0004_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Also transferred in from Mihoshi Academy...
　I'm $$ミハエル・ブラン$$.
　Just call me $$ミシェル$$.」

stage0004_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$兜甲児$$.
　Sorry for the commotion earlier.」

stage0004_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$甲児$$
「Motorcycles are my thing.
　Nice to meet you all!」

stage0004_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$詩織$$
「This time it's the wild type!」

stage0004_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$さやか$$
「$$弓さやか$$.
　Pleased to meet you.」

stage0004_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ボス$$
「Name's $$ボス$$.
　My real name is...」

stage0004_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ボス$$
「Anyway, nice to meet you!
　These are my men, $$ヌケ$$ and $$ムチャ$$!」

stage0004_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「Heh... can't wait to see if anyone here
　can go toe-to-toe with us.」

stage0004_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$恭子$$
「...I wonder where Miss Kagurazaka went.」

stage0004_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Maybe she's scouting for the school trip.」

stage0004_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ボス$$
「Wh-what's with that!
　Way less reaction than $$甲児$$ and $$アルト$$ got!」

stage0004_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$スズネ$$
「All right, class is about to start,
　so I'll leave the rest to you, Chidori.」

stage0004_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$先生$$... we'll get the rest from $$宗介$$.」

stage0004_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Man... I never thought I'd run into
　an old friend in a place like this, $$宗介$$.」

stage0004_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But if you're a friend of $$宗介$$'s,
　I might think twice about associating with you...!」

stage0004_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$アルト$$
（So she's the one $$ミスリル$$ is protecting...）

stage0004_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ミシェル$$
（The intel I got beforehand said she was
　cheerful and caring, like a big sister...）

stage0004_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$甲児$$
「Sorry...!
　Guess you had your own reasons too!」

stage0004_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$さやか$$
「Running into $$甲児$$ mid-training...
　what rotten luck.」

stage0004_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'll tell the whole class
　it was just a case of mistaken identity.」

stage0004_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Just what is going on here?」

stage0004_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$アルト$$
「Exactly what it looks like.
　We transferred in
　to back you up.」

stage0004_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$アルト$$
「More guards on hand makes things easier all around.」

stage0004_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Besides, we're still high schoolers ourselves.
　Apart from $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ duty,
　we've got a right to enjoy student life.」

stage0004_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$甲児$$
「Let me introduce myself properly.
　I'm $$兜甲児$$, pilot of $$マジンガーＺ$$.
　Nice to meet you, $$宗介$$.」

stage0004_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$宗介$$
「...As for this man's physical abilities,
　I confirmed them myself last night.
　I have no objection to his cooperation.」

stage0004_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$アルト$$
（Even saying that,
　he still doesn't seem convinced backup showed up.）

stage0004_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$クラン$$
「Cheer up, $$宗介$$.
　I'm the one who got stuck playing high schooler
　for this mission.」

stage0004_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$宗介$$
「My apologies, Captain $$クラン$$.
　Forcing a middle schooler to overextend herself.」

stage0004_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「As a Zentradi, sure, but
　seeing $$クラン$$ micloned down like that,
　it's no wonder he'd think that.」

stage0004_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$クラン$$
「Quiet, $$ミシェル$$!
　Honestly, the moment you transfer in,
　you start flirting with the girls...!」

stage0004_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well, $$アルト$$ and I do stand out together.」

stage0004_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミシェル$$, don't forget the mission.」

stage0004_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I know, I know.
　That's why we brought $$甲児$$ and the others in.」

stage0004_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$甲児$$
「Don't worry about it.
　I was curious about $$第２新東京市$$ anyway,
　and I can't sit still once bad guys start moving.」

stage0004_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ボス$$
「For my own ambition of uniting Japan,
　this academic city's a target too.」

stage0004_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's what he says, but
　$$ボス$$ just tagged along without being asked.」

stage0004_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ヌケ$$
「This gets me out of helping around
　《$$くろがね屋$$》 too.」

stage0004_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「Working there,
　you'd never have enough lives to spare.」

stage0004_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Captain $$クラン$$'s a third-year, I'm a first-year.
　This way we can guard $$千鳥かなめ$$
　from multiple angles.」

stage0004_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ came too, huh.」

stage0004_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm $$竹尾ワッ太$$.
　President of Takeo General Company,
　space jack-of-all-trades, pilot of $$トライダーＧ７$$.」

stage0004_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$n
「President...!?
　But you're clearly a grade schooler...!?」

stage0004_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$n
「Or is it like with Captain $$クラン$$...
　looks like a kid, but really much older...?」

stage0004_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Like you see, I really am a grade schooler.
　I inherited the company and Trider
　from my dad after he died in an accident.」

stage0004_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$ワッ太$$'s Takeo General Company
　signed on with Crusher Team,
　so now they fight alongside us.」

stage0004_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Since $$ワッ太$$ and I are grade schoolers,
　we'll act separately from the rest of you,
　defending Jindai High from the outside.」

stage0004_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's the situation, $$宗介$$.
　Defending this whole city from every angle
　is the point of this operation.」

stage0004_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$甲児$$
「Call us the Academy Defense Force...!
　Let's work together from here on.」

stage0004_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$宗介$$
「...If it's the mission, I have no objection.」

stage0004_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$さやか$$
「Speaking of Crusher Team,
　aren't $$タケル$$ and the others joining?」

stage0004_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$アルト$$
「I hear they're on a separate mission in space.
　Something about observing deep space conditions.」

stage0004_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$宗介$$
「Crusher Team, Earth Federation's Far East Branch...
　they belonged to 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》 during the $$再世戦争$$.」

stage0004_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$甲児$$
「An independent unit outside Earth Federation Forces.
　$$アルト$$, $$ワッ太$$, and I all fought together there.」

stage0004_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
???
「Indeed... and that $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$
　made us swallow bitter defeat, again and again...」

stage0004_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「That's right!
　The man back from hell, $$ブロッケン伯爵$$!」

stage0004_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$n
「He's got no head!
　Is that a 《$$デュラハン$$》!?」

stage0004_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$n
「A legend from Ireland about a headless man.
　You could call it a kind of monster.」

stage0004_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Fuhahahaha!
　Since some of you are meeting me for the first time,
　allow me to introduce myself properly!」

stage0004_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「My name is $$ブロッケン伯爵$$!
　Dr. Hell's loyal servant, a demon of vengeance
　risen from hell to avenge him!」

stage0004_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Fuhahahahaha!
　I am a man back from hell, after all!
　This much of a resurrection is child's play...」

stage0004_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「$$宗介$$, you just opened fire out of nowhere!」

stage0004_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$宗介$$
「Inexplicable entities like this get eliminated at once.」

stage0004_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nufufu... now that surprised me.
　Bringing a weapon into a school, of all things.」

stage0004_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$宗介$$
「I was aiming for a vital point...」

stage0004_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「As if my cyborg body
　would be fazed by a toy gun like that!」

stage0004_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$宗介$$
「Not even this brings him down.」

stage0004_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$甲児$$
「But that's plenty to hold him up!」

stage0004_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「W-wait, $$兜甲児$$!
　Lay a hand on me and you'll regret it!」

stage0004_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$甲児$$
「Shut up!
　I'll finish you off with the Photon Power laser gun!」

stage0004_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Wait!
　You don't care what happens to your classmate!?」

stage0004_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Hahaha!
　Take a look at that!」

stage0004_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...I understand the general situation now.」

stage0004_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Those students of yours
　have become a fine part of our fighting force.」

stage0004_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Do you intend to keep sending minors into battle?」

stage0004_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$オズマ$$
「That is not for us to decide, it is theirs.」

stage0004_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Then let me ask you...
　Are you fighting because you chose to?」

stage0004_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$アルト$$
「This is the life I chose when I left my father.」

stage0004_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$甲児$$
「I decided to use the power of Mazinger,
　which Grandpa entrusted to me, for peace.」

stage0004_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I took over the company and Trider from my dad.
　Can't just quit halfway through.」

stage0004_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I'll keep fighting bad guys too, together with
　$$鉄人$$, which Dad built for peace.」

stage0004_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$n
（Everyone... has their own reasons to fight...）

stage0004_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...What about you, $l?
　You ended up piloting that robot because
　you were dragged into it, weren't you?」

stage0004_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Besides, you haven't been a pilot for long.
　It's not too late, even now...」

stage0004_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$n
「No matter what anyone says,
　I have no intention of leaving the $$ジェニオン$$.」

stage0004_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Miss Saijou...
　It's only natural for you, as their teacher,
　to worry about them.」

stage0004_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But they are fighting of their own will.」

stage0004_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「And respecting that is a teacher's duty?」

stage0004_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You don't have to play the understanding adult.」

stage0004_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What's needed from an adult is to accept
　the will of the young, and help them judge
　whether it's right or wrong.」

stage0004_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...I can't show a will as strong as theirs.
　So I can't stop them from fighting,
　nor report this to the school.」

stage0004_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But I can't just stand by and watch
　my students put themselves in danger...!」

stage0004_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then how about this?
　Why not become an accomplice yourself, $$先生$$?」

stage0004_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ボス$$
「What is this robot!?
　Where'd it come from!」

stage0004_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But, $n...
　Even you didn't know of this $$ジェニオン$$ function...」

stage0004_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It seems that $$先生$$ riding along with you
　was the trigger for its activation.」

stage0004_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is just my guess, but...
　the $$ジェニオン$$ may have responded to your
　strong will to protect $$先生$$, $n...」

stage0004_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Who knows...
　I'm not exactly an expert on the technical
　side of things myself...」

stage0004_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Then what about $n rescuing her
　at super speed? What was that?」

stage0004_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I can't explain that one either, but...
　something must have taken effect when he
　was registered as the $$ジェニオン$$'s pilot...」

stage0004_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「According to my measurements,
　your physical ability, $n, was boosted
　to over 10 times normal at that moment...」

stage0004_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At the same time, your thinking speed and
　more seem to have gone 10 times as fast.」

stage0004_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So it's what they call a $$ブーストアップ$$...」

stage0004_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Taking the strain on your body, $n, into account,
　that $$ブーストアップ$$ seems to last about 10 seconds,
　and can't be used again within an hour.」

stage0004_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$n
「That's enough.
　It's the $$ジェニオン$$ lending me its strength.」

stage0004_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's not the only thing helping you.」

stage0004_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$,
　please let me join this organization
　to keep watch over my students.」

stage0004_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I've decided $l especially needs
　hands-on guidance.」

stage0004_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're a bit slow, $n.
　Miss $$スズネ$$ is saying she'll give you
　private lessons in the $$ジェニオン$$'s cockpit.」

stage0004_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「With me around, I can smooth things over
　at school too. You just transferred in...
　you don't want suspension or expulsion, right?」

stage0004_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Just as I can't stop you all,
　you can't stop my resolve either.」

stage0004_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Is that all right, Captain $$ジェフリー$$?」

stage0004_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Understood, Miss Saijou.
　I approve your joining us.」

stage0004_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And in respect for your resolve as a teacher,
　I'll address you as Sensei.」

stage0004_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, that's settled, let's refit the $$ジェニオン$$
　into a two-seater right away.」

stage0004_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$スズネ$$
「All right then, thank you, Mr. $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0004_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$アルト$$
「What... you're not gonna tell her to drop
　the 'Mr.'?」

stage0004_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hmm... I don't know why, but
　being called 'Mr.' by Miss $$スズネ$$
　feels okay to me.」

stage0004_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Ah, who cares!
　Nice to work with you, Miss $$スズネ$$...
　and you too, $n!」

stage0004_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$n
「...Unlike you, who endured that humiliation
　with calm judgment, I just lost control.」

stage0004_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$甲児$$
「I used to be just like you, y'know.」

stage0004_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$甲児$$
「So I don't hate that kind of thing!」

stage0004_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Me too!
　But let's do this together from now on,
　$n!」

stage0004_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Well then, let's be partners
　from now on, Knight.」

stage0004_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$スズネ$$
（Actually... I'm a regular on that $$オカルトフォーラム$$ too.
　I noticed the same habit in your posts
　in an essay from class, and it caught my eye.）

stage0004_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$スズネ$$
（Heh... it's not exactly a hobby either of us
　can brag about. I'll keep it quiet.）

stage0004_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$甲児$$
「What's up, $n.
　Sharing secrets with Miss $$スズネ$$ all of a sudden?」

stage0004_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's right.
　A secret between partners.」

stage0004_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「No fair, $n!
　I wanna be Miss $$スズネ$$'s partner too!」

stage0004_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Is that so.
　Then I'll expect big things from you and $$甲児$$.」

stage0004_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$甲児$$
「Leave it to us!
　We'll protect Jindai High and the town's peace!」

stage0004_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Heh... the Academy Defense Force starts for real now.」

stage0004_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Forgive me...!
　I wasted such valuable strength!」

stage0004_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「I, $$ブロッケン$$!
　will finish them off next time, without fail!」

stage0004_03:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Don't let it trouble you, $$ブロッケン$$.」

stage0004_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Today's battle was merely a probe.」

stage0004_03:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「I'll never forget the debt I owe you
　for saving me when I lay dying, $$あしゅら男爵$$.」

stage0004_03:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Let us join forces and avenge our master,
　Dr. Hell...!」

stage0004_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Of course, $$ブロッケン$$.
　Even with Dr. Hell dead, our fight goes on.」

stage0004_03:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「We shall defeat our nemesis, $$兜甲児$$ and
　$$マジンガーＺ$$, and offer this world at Dr. Hell's grave!」

stage0004_03:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Right!
　Next time, without fail!」

stage0004_03:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$あしゅら$$
（Heh heh... I'm counting on you, $$ブロッケン$$.）

stage0004_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$あしゅら$$
（Meanwhile, I'll make my preparations.
　Preparations for my true objective...）

stage0004_03:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ohh... truly beautiful!
　No wonder $$ブロッケン伯爵$$ is so smitten!」

stage0004_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thanks to your battle with $$ブロッケン伯爵$$,
　we harvested about 100Z worth of fine Z-Chips.
　I'll add these to the stock.」

stage0004_03:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ahh... Z-Chips earned by a lovely girl's
　own sacrifice...! Truly nectar of the gods!」

stage0004_03:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Well then, as Miss $$スズネ$$'s seat,
　we'll set up a sub-seat on top of the
　data-analysis equipment panel.」

stage0004_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Um... when riding in the robot,
　should I really wear something easy to move in?」

stage0004_03:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$スズネ$$
「In that position... um... a skirt would...」

stage0004_03:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No need to worry about that.
　When you board the $$ジェニオン$$, a combat suit
　is provided automatically.」

stage0004_03:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Now that you mention it, $n
　had changed clothes before I knew it too.」

stage0004_03:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That being the case,
　Miss $$スズネ$$, you needn't worry about
　a thing. Just come to the $$ジェニオン$$ as you are.」

stage0004_03:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Please take care of $n and me both.」

stage0004_03:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, I look forward to a long relationship.」

stage0004_03:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's get fired up... business, business!」
